items.title: Bulgaria presidential runoff Iotova–Valchev vs Gyurov–Kandev: round-1 CIK figures and turnout

items.note: Round 1 (25 Oct), CIK at 100% of protocols: Iotova–Valchev 34.76% (528,929), Gyurov–Kandev 31.95% (486,214), Kostadinov 12.55% (190,894), Vassilev 4.61%, 'I support no one' 4.43%, Mihaylov 3.79%, Hristanov 2.39%. Abroad: Gyurov 45.8%, Iotova 22.8% (focus-news.net). Turnout 22.93% of ~6.64m (riotimesonline.com/bulgaria-politics-explained-who-holds-power-2026/), the lowest since 1989 (burgasmedia). Runoff date 1 Nov confirmed (fakti.bg/bulgaria/1094290). In a runoff, a plurality wins and there is no turnout threshold (gna.org.gh). NO RUNOFF POLL FOUND in the 30 searches (capital.bg, dnevnik.bg and blitz.bg blocked fetching). The last pre-round-1 polls (Wikipedia table): Gallup 26 Sep–6 Oct 47.8/26.4; Myara 26 Sep–4 Oct 46.9/25.3; Trend 26 Sep–2 Oct 47.8/24.6; Alpha Research 24 Sep–1 Oct 44.5/26.1; Market Links 26–29 Sep 51.6/27.5. Alpha Research 23 Oct: 41.1/28.3 (sofiaglobe headline, not read). Every pollster overstated Iotova by 7–15 points. Round-1 parallel counts: Alpha 34.6/32.7, Myara 35.0/31.9, Trend 36.5/31.0, Gallup 36.6/31.8 (novinite 241250). Polymarket 27 Oct: Iotova 69.5%. Borissov-led group of ex-PMs endorsed Gyurov. Kostadinov (Revival) made no endorsement. CIK site https://www.cik.bg/ could not be fetched (permission timeout), so the results subpage URL is unverified.

The deficit is fixed after the 1st reading at CZK 386bn (MF table; August draft 389bn). Revenue is CZK 2,198.6bn and spending 2,584.6bn. It is 2.8% of GDP under the defence exemption, 3.5% without (NRR Hampl). The coalition plans shifts of at most a few billion (e.g. +sport agency). Defence is CZK 191bn (ČT24, 27 Oct). Sources: https://www.mfcr.cz/cs/ministerstvo/media/tiskove-zpravy/2026/rekordni-investice-dostupnejsi-zdravotnictvi-vyssi-65534 and ČT24 379073. items.title: Context/CORRECTION: Chamber media committee adjourned its debate on the fee-abolition bill until 10 December
items.title_cs: Mediální výbor přerušil projednávání zrušení poplatků do 10. prosince
items.note: Outside the window, but it matters for 31 Oct–13 Nov. Per the ČT24 homepage (30 Oct) headline 'Debatu o rušení poplatků pro ČT a ČRo přerušil sněmovní výbor do prosince', the committee resumes on 10 Dec. A second-reading vote on the fee bill in the 3–13 Nov window is therefore unlikely. Related article (29 Oct): https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/opozice-zatahla-media-verejne-sluzby-do-politickeho-boje-mini-klempir-379120
